notes.title: Game Updates
notes.notes: [p]Dear players:[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and love. In this update, we've optimized and adjusted the game experience. The details are as follows:[/p][p]🔥 Benefit Optimization[/p][p]1. Diamond Reward Enhancement** — Double the diamond bonus** for a more enjoyable experience![/p][p]2. Daily Quest Adjustments** — Added **Stamina Output**, allowing you to easily enjoy more adventures![/p][p]3. Seven-Day Event Update** — Comprehensively enhanced event rewards and more benefits![/p][p]4. Monthly Pass Benefit Enhancement** — Increased daily diamond output for a better value![/p][p]5. Online Reward Optimization** — Reduced the claim interval from **90 minutes to 30 minutes**, making it easier to earn rewards![/p][p]⚔️ System Adjustments[/p][p]6. Guild Quest Optimization** — Removed the Hot Spring Ticket output to focus more on core rewards.[/p][p]7. Steam Platform Update** — Added **Full Screen Function** for an even more immersive experience![/p][p]Come and experience this version update, more exciting content is waiting for you to explore! 🎉[/p]
